<!DOCTYPE html PUBLIC "-//W3C//DTD HTML 4.0 Transitional//EN">
<HTML>
<head>
    <META content="text/html; charset=utf-8" http-equiv=Content-Type></META>
    <META content=IE=8 http-equiv=X-UA-Compatible></META>
</head>
<body>
<div id="app"></div>
<script>window.accordion=%accordion%</script>
<style>
    @font-face {
        font-family: 'Inter';
        src: url(data:font/truetype;charset=utf-8;base64,) format('truetype');
        font-weight: normal;
        font-style: normal;
    }
</style>
<style>
    * {
        margin: 0;
        box-sizing: border-box;
    }
    html, body {
        height: 100%;
        overflow: hidden;
    }
    body {
        font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif;
        color: #000;
        width: 100%;
    }
    #app {
        width: 100%;
        height: 100%;
    }
    .header {
        height: 30px;
        margin-bottom: 6px;
        pointer-events: none;
    }
    .header__logo {
        height: 28px;
        width: 84px;
        margin-left: 11px;
    }
    /* Отдельные строки для шапки, списка и футера: прокручивается только список. */
    .accordion-layout {
        width: 100%;
        height: 100%;
        border-collapse: collapse;
        table-layout: fixed;
    }
    .accordion-layout__header {
        padding-top: 26px;
        vertical-align: top;
    }
    .accordion-layout__content {
        height: 100%;
        vertical-align: top;
    }
    .accordion-layout__footer {
        vertical-align: bottom;
    }
    /* Ограничивает высоту списка; в IE7–10 её уточняет App._updateLayout. */
    .accordion__viewport {
        height: 100%;
        position: relative;
        overflow: hidden;
    }
    .accordion__wrapper {
        position: absolute;
        top: 0;
        left: 0;
        width: 100%;
        height: 100%;
        overflow-x: hidden;
        overflow-y: auto;
        -ms-overflow-style: none;
    }
    .tree-item {
        margin-bottom: 2px;
        cursor: pointer;
        align-items: center;
        padding: 13px 12px 12px 12px;
        position: relative;
        border-radius: 8px;
        user-select: none;
    }
    .tree-item.tree-item__selected {
        background: #f3f4f8!important;
    }
    .tree-item__children {
        padding: 7px 12px 6px 12px;
    }
    .tree-item__children .tree-item__title {
        font-size: 13px;
        width: 180px;
    }
    .icon {
        height: 20px;
        width: 20px;
        margin-right: 12px;
        vertical-align: middle;
    }
    .tree-item__title {
        font-size: 16px;
        white-space: nowrap;
        overflow: hidden;
        text-overflow: ellipsis;
        vertical-align: middle;
    }
    .expander {
        margin-left: 6px;
        position: absolute;
        right: 12px;
        top: 18px;
        width: 7px;
        height: 12px;
    }
    .expander__expanded {
        width: 12px!important;
        height: 7px!important;
        top: 21px!important;
    }
    .item__selection {
        position: absolute;
        left: -13px;
        top: 14px;
        height: 12px;
        width: 3px;
        background: #0c94ff;
        display: none;
    }
    .item__selection__children {
        top: 7px;
        left: -43px;
    }
    .tree-item__selected .item__selection {
        display: block;
    }
    .footer {
        margin: 8px 0 8px 12px;
    }
    /* Информер отключённых пользовательских настроек. */
    .footer__user-settings {
        /* Отступ .footer равен 12px: сдвиг на -8px оставляет 4px от левого края. */
        margin: 0 8px 12px -8px;
        padding: 6px 8px;
        border: 1px solid #F88F62;
        color: #000;
    }
    .footer__user-settings-message {
        margin: 0 0 4px;
        font-size: 11px;
        line-height: normal;
    }
    .footer__user-settings-enable {
        display: block;
        padding: 0;
        border: 0;
        background: transparent;
        color: #CC3D00;
        font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif;
        font-size: 14px;
        line-height: normal;
        text-align: left;
        text-decoration: none;
        cursor: hand;
        cursor: pointer;
    }
    .footer__user-settings-enable:hover {
        text-decoration: underline;
    }
    .footer__version {
        margin-top: 4px;
    }
    .footer__version-0,
    .footer__version-1 {
        color: #8991a9;
    }
    .footer__status-1 {
        color: #2562AA
    }
    .footer__status-2,
    .footer__status-3,
    .footer__version-2,
    .footer__version-3 {
        color: #C2140A;
    }
    .footer__status-3 {
        font-weight: bold;
    }
    .footer__version, .footer__status {
        cursor: pointer;
    }
</style>

        AccordionItem.prototype.mount = function ($parent) {
            this._root = document.createElement('div');
            this._root.className = 'tree-item';
            if (this._options.level > 1) {
                this._root.style.paddingLeft = '44px';
                this._root.className += ' tree-item__children';
            }
            if (this._isSelected()) {
                this._setSelected();
            }
            if (this._options['icon']) {
                var accItemIcon = document.createElement('img');
                accItemIcon.className = 'icon';
                accItemIcon.src = this._iconLib[this._options.icon];
                this._root.appendChild(accItemIcon);
            }
            var accItemTitle = document.createElement('span');
            accItemTitle.className = 'tree-item__title';
            accItemTitle.innerHTML = this._options.title;
            accItemTitle.title = this._options.title;
            this._root.appendChild(accItemTitle);
            if (this._isParent()) {
                this._expanderEl = document.createElement('img');
                this._expanderEl.src = this._iconLib.Expander;
                this._expanderEl.className = 'expander';
                this._root.appendChild(this._expanderEl);
            }
            this._selectionEl = document.createElement('div');
            this._selectionEl.className = 'item__selection';
            if (this._options.level > 1) {
                this._selectionEl.className += ' item__selection__children';
            }
            this._root.appendChild(this._selectionEl);
            this._setVisibility();
            _super.prototype.mount.call(this, $parent);
        };
        AccordionItem.prototype._isParent = function () {
            return !!this._options['parent@'];
        };
        AccordionItem.prototype._isExpended = function () {
            return this._options.expanderItems.indexOf(this._options.id) > -1;
        };
        AccordionItem.prototype._isSelected = function () {
            return this._options.selectedItem.value === this._options.id;
        };
        AccordionItem.prototype._setVisibility = function () {
            // Любая дочерняя строка, включая раздел с parent@: true, зависит от всех предков.
            var item = this._options;
            // При циклических ссылках родителей прекращаем обход и скрываем строку.
            var visitedParents = {};
            var visible = true;
            while (item && item.level > 1) {
                var parentKey = '$' + item.parent;
                if (visitedParents[parentKey] || this._options.expanderItems.indexOf(item.parent) === -1) {
                    visible = false;
                    break;
                }
                visitedParents[parentKey] = true;
                item = this._options.itemsById[parentKey];
            }
            this._root.style.display = visible ? 'block' : 'none';
        };
        AccordionItem.prototype._setSelected = function () {
            this._root.className += ' tree-item__selected';
        };
        AccordionItem.prototype.update = function () {
            if (this._isSelected()) {
                if (this._root.className.indexOf('tree-item__selected') === -1) {
                    this._setSelected();
                }
            }
            else {
                this._root.className = this._root.className.replace('tree-item__selected', '');
            }
            if (this._isParent() && this._isExpended()) {
                this._expanderEl.src = this._iconLib.ExpanderDown;
                this._expanderEl.className += ' expander__expanded';
            }
            else if (this._isParent() && !this._isExpended()) {
                this._expanderEl.src = this._iconLib.Expander;
                this._expanderEl.className = this._expanderEl.className.replace('expander__expanded', '');
            }
            this._setVisibility();
            _super.prototype.update.call(this);
        };
        AccordionItem.prototype.afterMount = function () {
            this._root.onclick = function () {
                this._options.itemClickHandler(this._options);
            }.bind(this);
            if (this._expanderEl) {
                this._expanderEl.onclick = function () {
                     window.event.cancelBubble = true;
                    this._options.expanderClickHandler(this._options);
                }.bind(this);
            }
        };
        return AccordionItem;
    }(Component));
    new App().mount();
</script>
